storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
Video Downloader for YouTube makes it easy to save YouTube videos to your computer — directly from your browser.

How it works: Go to any YouTube video and press play. A download button appears right on the video player. Click it, or click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension extracts all available formats from YouTube's API, shows quality options, and downloads the video as a standard MP4 file.

It handles YouTube's adaptive streaming, signature protection, and format negotiation automatically. Multiple YouTube API clients are queried to find every available quality — from 144p to 4K. HLS and SABR streaming pipelines provide fallbacks when direct downloads aren't available. Separate video and audio streams are merged automatically.

Works on YouTube.com and detects embedded YouTube videos on any website. Copy yt-dlp commands for advanced users who prefer the command line.

Key features:
- In-page download button right on the YouTube player
- Multi-client format extraction pulls all available qualities
- Automatic HLS-to-MP4 and SABR/UMP streaming support
- Quality selection from every resolution YouTube offers
- Real-time download progress with speed display
- Download queue supporting up to 3 concurrent downloads
- Detects embedded YouTube videos on any website
- Copy yt-dlp commands for Mac and Windows
- Cross-tab download progress synchronization
- Dark-themed UI matching YouTube's look
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to YouTube.com and play any video
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select your quality and download — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a YouTube video?
faq.answer: Go to any video on YouTube.com and press play. Click the download button that appears on the player, or click the extension icon in your toolbar. Select your preferred quality and click Download.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension queries multiple YouTube API clients to find every available format — typically from 144p up to 4K, depending on the video. Progressive (combined audio+video) formats are preferred, with separate audio/video streams merged automatically when needed.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. When separate video and audio streams are downloaded, they are automatically merged into a single MP4.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: The browser's save-as dialog appears so you can choose where to save. There is no forced download folder.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Can I download YouTube videos embedded on other websites?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects YouTube iframes and links on any website and shows download buttons next to them.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding my video?
faq.answer: Press play on the video first. The extension needs the video to load before it can extract formats. If issues persist, refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: What is the yt-dlp command feature?
faq.answer: For advanced users, the popup includes buttons to copy yt-dlp commands for Mac and Windows, in case you prefer to download via the command line.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All video processing happens locally in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored. The extension does not collect or transmit any personal data.
